tutorial.title: Build the HungerStation vs QC report
tutorial.finished: Done. This is the report your team can re-run with any period. Schedule it from Share once 803 is drawn.
tutorial.loadHint: Skip to the end and study it. Undo takes you back to where you were.

title.title: Name the report
title.how: Type a title at the top, e.g. "Channel sales: HungerStation against QC". The Arabic title is optional.

section.title: Add a section
section.how: Use "+ Section" and call it "Sales by channel". Sections are read top to bottom.

chart.title: Chart net sales by channel
chart.how: In the section, add a "Chart or table". It starts as net sales by channel, a bar chart; give it a title.

series.title: Compare HungerStation against QC
series.how: Add another chart, then two named series: one where Channel is HungerStation, one where Delivery type is QC. Each series runs on its own.

rate.title: Show their cancellation rates
rate.how: Switch that chart (or a copy) to the Orders area and pick Cancellation rate. Set the axis to Date.

figure.title: Write a sentence with a live figure
figure.how: Add Text and use "Insert a live figure" to drop in, say, HungerStation's rate. It refreshes on every run.

summary.title: Add the AI summary
summary.how: Add "AI summary" to a last section. It is rewritten each run and its numbers are checked.

period.title: Check the period: yesterday, on every chart
period.how: Open the Period parameter. Its default should be Yesterday, and "Applies to" should tick every chart.

share.title: Share it with your team
share.how: Use Share, choose "Chosen teams and people" and pick a team. They can run it, not change it.

save.title: Save
save.how: Save. If it is refused, the list names what to fix: often a parameter that can't reach a chart with series.
